Let's touch on the status of validator custody in PeerDAS.

I have been hearing about some implementation difficulties with the dynamic variant of this feature, and wonder if we should move to a static variant.

# PeerDAS & fusaka-devnet-0/1 Updates:

## **Discord Update**
- 🚫 `#peerdas-testing` has been archived
- ✅ `interop-🏙️` is now the default home 

## **Fusaka-devnet-0 Status**
### 🚢 **Successfully launched May 26th**
  - ✅ Running with Fulu fork at epoch 256
  - ✅ BPO mechanism working as intended (changes every 256 epochs)
  - ✅ Network participation recovered to 100% after initial Besu sync issues
  - ✅ Test releases completed:
    - Consensus specs V1.6.0-alpha.0
    - Execution spec tests fusaka-devnet-0@v1.0.0
  - ✅ Beacon API PeerDAS changes (EIP-7594) merged
###  ⚠️ **Known Issues** (Still Present?)
  - Sync problems with certain client combinations (Grandine/Lodestar)
  - Orphaned/skipped blocks with Nimbus
  - Some client images still pending deployment

## **Fusaka-devnet-1 Planning**
- 🎯 **Target launch: June 9th**
- **Scope includes:**
  - [EIP-7594: PeerDAS - Peer Data Availability Sampling](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/ed447a1105230659fdce084710ae36bc309ff99f/EIPS/eip-7594.md)
  - [EIP-7823: Set upper bounds for MODEXP](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/master/EIPS/eip-7823.md)
  - [EIP-7825: Transaction Gas Limit Cap](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/master/EIPS/eip-7825.md) :new: 
  - [EIP-7883: MODEXP Gas Cost Increase](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7883)
  - [EIP-7892: BPO (Blob Parameter Only) Hardforks](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7892)
  - [EIP-7917: Deterministic proposer lookahead](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7917) :new:
  - [EIP-7918: Blob base fee bounded by execution cost](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7918) :new:


## **Critical Action Items for This Week**

### **1. EIP-7917 Implementation (Urgent)**
- Just SFI'd on May 29th ACDC call for devnet-1
- Introduces beacon state changes to Fusaka
- Must be ready for June 9th timeline
- Don't let "trivial" description cause delays

### **2. Validator Custody Specification Resolution (Monday)**
- Current spec too dynamic, causing implementation difficulties
- Proposal: shift to simpler, more static approach (~every 32 ETH)
- Deferred from last week - key contributors weren't present
- **Must participate in Monday ACDT discussion**

### **3. BPO Networking Changes**
- Decision made: use fork digest changes + ENR enhancements
- Specifically avoiding fork version changes (less invasive approach)
- Raúl preparing updated PR - watch for availability

### **4. New Metrics Implementation**
- Beacon custody groups (Gauge)
- Beacon custody groups backfilled (Gauge)  
- Beacon engine getBlobsV2 requests total (Counter)
- Beacon engine getBlobsV2 responses total (Counter)
- Beacon engine getBlobsV2 runtime seconds (Histogram)
- Beacon engine getBlobsV2 metrics for EL side (J from Sunnyside flagged this)


## **Testing Results & Performance Insights**
- **Sunnyside testing:** 
  - May 30th Sunnyside Devnet Updates [here](https://testinprod.notion.site/Sunnyside-Devnet-Updates-05-30-2008fc57f54680ea81cde6acaa6d55fc?source=copy_link)
  - ~15% higher blob counts with getBlobsV2 enabled
- **Performance:** Reached ~50 blobs/block with diverse client mix
- **Bottlenecks identified:** 
  - Geth blobpool limitations (42.6MB cap)
  - More verification failures with getBlobsV2 enabled

## **Week Checklist Summary**
1. ✅ ACDT -> Resolve: Validator Custody spec
2. ✅ Finalize EIP-7917 implementation for June 9th
3. ✅ Monitor devnet-0 for issues
4. ✅ Implement new metrics if not already done
5. ✅ Review BPO networking PR when available
Hi @will-corcoran, can we also discuss getBlobsV2 metrics for EL side as well? Thanks!
